title: Protocol Risk Simulation Engine built by Xerberus

ms.promise: As a research-driven project, our first milestone will be the creation of an in-depth paper that outlines the challenges and potential solutions involved in developing a comprehensive simulation for DeFi protocols. This paper will serve as a foundational guide, exploring key issues such as risk management, capital efficiency, and market dynamics in the context of DeFi on Cardano.
ms.criteria:
The output is acceptable if the paper outlines a risk simulation framework for DeFi protocols. The paper should contain sections such as: 
・Introduction to the Tool
・Challenges in DeFi Lending Protocols (What is the problem we are trying to solve?)
・Core Components of the Tool (What are the elements we create to solve the issue?)
・Parameters for Lending Protocols (What avenues do we have to solve the issue/optimize within DeFi?)
・Stress-Testing Process (What are we testing for?)
・Governance Mechanisms (Role of governance in maintaining protocol efficiency and resilience.)
・Challenges and Solut

To ensure a seamless user experience, this milestone will involve the creation of a detailed software architecture plan. This plan will consist of various diagrams and written documentation outlining the structure and components of the system.

ms.promise:
Our third milestone focuses on designing an accessible user interface. Creating a simulation tool can be complex, so an intuitive and user-friendly interface is crucial to make it easier for developers to navigate and use the simulation. 
As part of this milestone, we will design wireframes showcasing the simulation engine interface. These wireframes will allow Catalyst reviewers to understand how end users will interact with the simulation tool. 
Additionally, we will provide a video explanation of the engine to offer context and clarity, as some aspects of the simulation may be challenging to grasp without guidance.
ms.criteria:
The milestone is to be accepted if the interface is understandable. To be precise, the milestone criteria will be considered complete if the team delivers:
 • An accessible and user-friendly interface design
 • A walkthrough video explaining the interface and its functionality
 • Wireframes showcasing the design of the simulation engine
ms.report:
